About the jobDesign products people want to use in real life
Unreal Urban builds technology that brings people, communities and cities together. Our first flagship product, Falorin, is a live web and mobile platform for discovering, creating and joining real-world experiences.

We are looking for a hands-on Founding Product / UX Designer to make Falorin clearer, more useful and more delightful at every step—from first discovery to creating or joining an experience. You will help turn real user behaviour and community insight into simple, high-quality product experiences.

This is an early-stage, equity-based collaboration; there is no cash salary at this stage. Equity will be discussed transparently with strong candidates based on scope, commitment and contribution.

What you'll do

- Own end-to-end product and UX design for Falorin across web and mobile.

- Turn user research, feedback and behavioural data into flows, prototypes and polished interfaces.

- Simplify the critical journeys: discovery, onboarding, creation, joining and returning.

- Work directly with founders, engineering and growth to prioritise the highest-impact product improvements.

- Help establish a flexible design system that can support future Unreal Urban products.

What we're looking for

- Strong portfolio of product/UX work for consumer, marketplace, social or mobile products.

- Excellent user-flow, interaction and visual design judgement.

- Comfortable moving from problem framing and quick prototypes to implementation-ready detail.

- Practical fluency with Figma and close collaboration with developers.

- Curious about how digital products can improve real-world connection.

Why join
You will shape a live flagship product at an important early stage, with real ownership over what users see, feel and do. Your work on Falorin can become the design foundation for a broader Unreal Urban portfolio.

Job DescriptionAbout the Role
We're looking for a Product Designer  Design Systems to join our design systems team and help elevate the consistency, usability, and visual language of all our products. You'll play a critical role in building and maintaining Fynd Design System (Novus)  our design system  collaborating closely with designers, developers, and product teams to ship scalable, accessible components and patterns. What will you do at Fynd
Design, document, and maintain reusable components, patterns, and tokens in Figma. Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of design tokens and UI components Define and uphold visual and interaction standards that align with Fynd's brand and accessibility goals. Drive adoption of the design system across product teams through guidance, documentation, and training.Audit product experiences for inconsistencies and propose improvements via the system. Collaborate with other designers to ensure their work aligns with system foundations and evolves our design language. Contribute to tooling and process improvements that enhance system contribution and maintenance workflows. Some specific Requirements
24 years of experience in product design with at least 12 years focused on design systems. Proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto-layout, variants, and tokens. Experience in B2B SaaS UX . Worked on B2B SaaS design systems. Excellent visual design skills with a keen eye for typography, spacing, and hierarchy. A systems thinker with an obsessive attention to detail and a love for documentation. Experience collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and design teams. Familiarity with accessibility principles (WCAG) and inclusive design practices. Familiarity with AI tools and usage of AI in day to day tasks is a must. Good to have
Prior experience maintaining or contributing to a cross-platform(multi brand) design system. Experience with motion design for micro-interactions. You have a good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScriptWhy You'll Love Working at Fynd A growing design culture with ambitious, supportive teammates. Opportunity to work on a large-scale design system used across multiple industries, products and surfaces. Ownership, autonomy, and the ability to influence system strategy and evolution. Competitive compensation and wellness benefits A culture that values clarity, craft, care, and collaboration .

Job DescriptionDesigner, Content Production As one of the worlds leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco. Job Description Who we are With over $1.58 trillion of assets under management, Invesco is one of the worlds leading global investment management firms, headquartered in Atlanta, GA. Spreading across 26 countries and with over 8400 dedicated employees, we are driven by trust and care. As one of the worlds leading asset managers, we are solely dedicated to delivering an investment experience that helps people get more out of life. If you're looking for challenging work, thoughtful colleagues, and a global employer with social values, explore your potential at Invesco. Your Team In support of Invescos position as a leading independent global investment management company which provides a comprehensive array of enduring investment solutions for retail, institutional and high net worth clients around the world, this position is responsible for executing marketing communications including high-level print and electronic production & multi-media support, while providing expert support in industry-specific programs, file management and work processes in support of the companys marketing/sales initiatives and regulatory requirements. Your Role Design and produce marketing collateral, brochures, infographics, forms, electronic corporate presentation materials and other digital and print communication materials, under minimal supervision Ensure all deliverables comply with brand guidelines, meet quality standards and production requirements through thorough self-review to ensure accuracy and consistency Manage multiple projects simultaneously, assess requirements, and deliver work within established timelines Take ownership of assigned projects from initiation through completion while meeting agreed timelines and stakeholder expectations Leverage AI-enabled productivity and design tools to improve efficiency, creativity, and turnaround times while maintaining quality standards. Follow diligent file management / organizes & archives files according to established departmental processes Become proficient in utilizing web-based job trafficking system (Aprimo) to manage all production tasks The Experience You Bring 2+ years of experience in graphic design, content production, or creative services supporting multiple projects in a fast-paced environment Strong understanding of graphic design principles, typography, layout, branding, print production, video editing and motion graphics creation Proficiency in Adobe CC tools, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, Acrobat, Premier and After Effects Experience with video editing, motion graphics, and multimedia content development is a plus. Knowledge in producing/editing HTML5/CSS3 email templates / banners is added advantage Exposure to Adobe Firefly, Generative AI tools, and AI-powered video editing platforms will be a plus Skills/Other Personal Attributes Required: Ability to work independently and with the team; flexible to work on multiple projects and meet tight deadlines maintaining quality standards Ability to review/troubleshoot files and provide effective, thoughtful solutions to issues in a professional and productive manner Effectively communicate with a variety of individuals at all technical levels across our global network Team player  ability to communicate and work effectively as part of a team Open minded, flexible, and willing to listen to other opinions Strong organizational skills and detail oriented Academic requirements An Associate's degree in graphic design, visual communications or related field preferred. Two years of work experience in technical graphic design & content production/page layout/file management may be considered in lieu of educational requirements. Full Time / Part Time Full time Worker Type Employee Job Exempt (Yes / No) No Workplace Model At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office. Why Invesco In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each others identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by .
